slides.title: Initial Access
slides.html:
For the first time, you access your Deploy App with a first-admin code.

  • Your service operator should provide you with a link to your instance and a first admin code.
  • Login with the code provided. Remember! First-admin codes are one-use only, so when using one, do complete the login flow. Else you have used the code and gained no access with it.

slides.title: Callsign
slides.html:
As with standard user login, give yourself a callsign.

  • This should be something your organization can identify you with.
  • It will be used across all services.

slides.title: Instructions
slides.html:
• Deploy App has built in instructions to instruct users and highlight key features.
  • This guide will go through certificate installation.

slides.title: Download the certificate
slides.html:
Unlike inviting users, using a first admin code will directly land you to downloading your client cert.

  • This will act as your way to access the services.
  • You do not need passwords with Deploy App, as the cert will be your ID.

slides.title: Install your certificate
slides.html:
With Android, installing the cert is straightforward.

  • Your callsign acts as your password.
  • Type it and press OK until you are back in Deploy App.

slides.title: Login with the certificate
slides.html:
• Press "Navigate with your key".
  • When prompted to choose a certificate, check that your callsign is selected and press "Select" to login.

slides.title: Success
slides.html:
• Now you can start using apps as well as enrolling users.
  • Deploy App shows you some instructions the first time.
